retention: Keep the active item and at most two recently passing items; durable outcomes belong in specifications, ADRs, commits, and reviews.

items.title: Create the Rust workspace foundation and delivery checks
acceptance: The proposed Cargo workspace and crate dependency direction are represented.
An empty CLI builds and its help output is testable.
Formatting, Clippy, tests, dependency policy, and secret scanning have executable checks.
SECURITY.md and CONTRIBUTING.md encode the approved security and fixture boundaries.

verification.outcome: not run due account usage limit; explicitly deferred and non-blocking by user direction

items.title: Implement the versioned non-secret profile registry
acceptance: Profile IDs, validated names, providers, storage locators, and statuses are strongly typed.
Registry schema v1 round-trips without storing credential material or full account emails.
Writes use a same-directory temporary file, flush, atomic replacement, and a mutation lock.
Duplicate case-folded names, unsupported schema versions, corrupt JSON, and unsafe file types fail closed.
Migration scaffolding and synthetic unit, integration, and property-style invariant tests pass.

verification.outcome: advisories, bans, licenses, and sources passing

items.title: Implement safe official-client discovery and process execution
acceptance: Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI executables can be discovered through PATH or an explicit override without shell evaluation.
Discovery rejects missing, non-regular, non-executable, and unsafe explicit paths with typed errors.
A bounded process runner captures version output, exit status, timeout, and truncation without retaining credential-bearing output.
Child arguments are passed as argv values and fake-client tests prove shell metacharacters are never evaluated.
The installed agy executable is detected and version 1.1.2 is reported through the new abstraction without accessing authentication state.

verification.outcome: passing; 20 tests and 1 expected ignored installed-client smoke test
advisories, bans, licenses, and sources passing

verification.command: GEMINI_AUTH_TEST_AGY=/root/.local/bin/agy GEMINI_AUTH_TEST_AGY_VERSION=1.1.2 cargo test -p antigravity-auth-process --test installed_client -- --ignored --exact discovers_and_probes_installed_agy_without_authentication
verification.outcome: passing; agy 1.1.2 discovered and probed without authentication access

items.title: Pivot the product and repository sources to Antigravity CLI
acceptance: The product, binary, workspace crates, manifest, and current documentation use the antigravity-auth name.
Antigravity CLI is the sole MVP provider and Gemini CLI is documented only as deferred legacy/enterprise compatibility.
The roadmap requires capability research before any real authentication-state mutation.
The unmerged Gemini isolated-home pull request is closed with its rationale preserved.
All local build, test, dependency, secret, link, and harness checks pass after the migration.

verification.outcome: advisories, bans, licenses, and sources passing
passing; installed agy 1.1.2 discovered without authentication access
